blocks.text: NEW YORK — Franz Wagner scored 35 points, including a game-winning jumper with 2.4 seconds left, and the Orlando Magic beat the Brooklyn Nets 113-111 in an NBA Cup game on Friday night. Facing his older brother and former teammate Mo Wagner for the first time after spending their last five seasons together in Orlando, Franz Wagner stepped back and hit a 14-foot jumper steps away from the Nets bench.
